title: ContextMenuOpenedParams
description: Sent on contextmenu while enabled, so the native menu can offer the actions that fit the selection. Without a selection, text is empty and actions is empty.

sourceLanguage.description: The page's language tag for the selection, from the nearest lang attribute.

editable.description: Whether the selection is in an editable field. Absent without a selection.

actions.description: The actions that fit, ranked, without "ask".
